title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Billing Desk Note: Window for Counting Earlier Shipping-Fee Credits
content:
## Billing desk guidance: the prior-credit window

**Rule.** For a Home Delivery Pharmacy account, the prior-credit window depends on how long the account has been open on the handling date: for an account open 60 whole months or more it covers shipping-fee credits dated less than 24 whole months before the handling date, for an account open less than 12 whole months it covers credits dated less than 6 whole months before, and for every other account it covers credits dated less than 12 whole months before.

Months open are whole months from the account's opened date to the handling date. Shipping-fee credits are credits posted with the reason shipping fee waived.

### Window by months open

| Whole months open on the handling date | Shipping-fee credits counted are those dated less than |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 24 whole months before |
| 12 through 59 | 12 whole months before |
| fewer than 12 | 6 whole months before |

### Boundary pairs (hypothetical accounts)

- 60 whole months open: 24-month window. 59: 12-month window.
- 12 whole months open: 12-month window. 11: 6-month window.
